answer.summary: No prior research question in Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1 provides explicit evidence of memory mechanisms beyond feature-based analysis under stable conditions.
answer.content: The current body of evidence fails to document any non-feature-based, observable indicators of memory coherence, persistence, or responsiveness in stable environments. A new, narrow research focus is required to investigate explicitly described mechanisms without inference or speculation.
